notes: One level of three co-transmitters: «قال أبو الطاهر حدثنا وقال الآخران» only changes the verb (حدثنا / أخبرنا), so the three are one level, not two routes.
The text is cut off after «إذا كان يوم الجمعة»; the saying is incomplete, the chain is read as written.
«أبو عبد الله، الأغر» is one man written with a comma; «أبا هريرة» is the Companion who heard the Prophet.
